name: Yoshima: Hentai Simulator
source:
Yoshima: Hentai Simulator is a 2D game with a lot of mechanics. It is always exhausting to look for apartment, but fortune is at your side now! Welcome your new roommate, Yoshima! Can you find the key to her heart? Don't forget to pay the rent!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3298250]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《吉岛：合租生活》是一款有着多种玩法的二维游戏。找房子总是让人精疲力竭，不过这回好运站在你这边！来认识你的新室友吉岛吧！你能找到打开她心扉的钥匙吗？可别忘了交房租！

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3298250]Steam[/url]］
